answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ridge graph. Re-attestations are stored in vertex and spiral lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4774 identities would post 1121 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
